# Hash-locked CI requirements for Ruff and mypy. Every package has a hash for
# CPython 3.13 on Linux x86_64, the CI platform; Dependabot updates may add
# hashes for other platforms, so the set is complete only there. Every hash
# was checked against PyPI. Regenerate only after reviewing package
# provenance and wheel hashes; Dependabot proposes updates (.github/dependabot.yml).
# CI installs with --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes.
